newsitem.title: USA: A&B receives $33.6 mln lawsuit settlement.
newsitem.headline: A&B receives $33.6 mln lawsuit settlement.

text.p: Alexander & Baldwin Inc said Thursday it has received payment of $33.65 million as settlement from Home Insurance Co from a lawsuit that involved insurance claims over damage resulting from the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake.

The suit, filed in 1990, sought recovery of damages sustained at the Oakland marine container terminal operated by Alexander & Baldwin unit Matson Terminals Inc. In January 1993, the trial court awarded Matson Terminals compensatory and punitive damages of $23.5 million, plus post-judgment interest at 10 percent per year.

The company said in a statement that after repair and litigation costs the company will record an additional $21 million of pretax income in the first quarter of 1997. After taxes, this will add about $13 million, or about $0.29 a share, to earnings for the quarter.
